title: When life starts feeling aimless as a steady practice
issueStatement: The day fills up, but the inner reason for being here feels thin. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and Naam rather than mere maintenance. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Use this life for meeting, not merely for managing. Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift.
actionPrompt: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. Repeat what you can actually keep.
